fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects addition of users to the local administrator group via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".
fields.name: User Added to Local Administrators Group
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.cmdline contains "localgroup " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " /add") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "Add-LocalGroupMember " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -Group ")) and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " administrators " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " administrateur")))
